subject: If you don't know me by now...
author: ZombieTron
body:
I am 36 already! Currently a Husmor which is Norwegian for stay at home Mum. Our baby girl is 9 months old now, she is very close to walking and she keeps me very busy. This means I don't have a lot of time for playing games or maintaining this site. When I am playing games I will probably be playing Burnout Revenge, Split/Second or Peggle!

I live with Xandu, who is Norwegian, and we started this site together because we met on Burnout 3 on Xbox Live and we both adore the Burnout series. (although my love for Burnout Paradise is very small!)

Other than looking forward to NFS:HP I am also looking forward to TRON. 🤓

My favourite car remains the Super Assassin Super from Burnout 3, with the Revenge Racer being a close second.

I use my BurnoutAholics blog to rant and talk about life in general, feel free to read it if you want to know more about me!🙂
